Episode 196. The Great Snake, Ameris (1)

Originally, Jin planned to bring Valeria for record investigation if something special came out during the excavation. However, the voice coming from under the ground didn't seem to give Jin the time to do so.
Suddenly, there was a violent vibration as if the pit was sinking. It felt as if the entire underground was writhing as if it were a part of the creature.
The size of the creature was unimaginable. Jin and Hedo swung their swords to clear the debris falling like a waterfall, and first leapt towards the ground.
"Jin, have you ever heard of a dragon living underground?"
"No, I haven't. Don't even earth dragons typically live above ground? I'm not even sure if it's really a dragon."
"It does seem too big to be a dragon."
Who dared to awaken me?!
The voice echoed again, shaking the world. If it had been an average or slightly excellent warrior, they would have fainted just from hearing the voice up close.
"It's Jin Runcandel."
Jin replied in the softest voice he could muster. Although the creature asked sharply, Jin was the one who had woken it from its slumber, so he had to respond kindly.
"I'm Hedo of the Vamel Union. I don't have a surname."

The scene outside the pit was truly disastrous. While the distortion of the ground due to excavation was undoubtedly their doing, the whirlpool spread in all directions was not. The whirlpool, swallowing up all the remaining debris on the ground, was caused by the movement of the owner of the scales.
The whirlpool was frighteningly fast in swallowing up the surface. The whole ground had already sunk significantly, and Jin and Hedo first checked on Shuri.
Fortunately, a green signal flare signaling safety was shining in the distant sky. Jin and Hedo exchanged glances and waited for the owner of the scales to reveal himself.
Finally, its face and part of its neck emerged from the ground.
'A dragon? No… it looks more like a snake.'
The owner of the scales was a giant black snake. Like snakes seen in the wild, it had a forked tongue.
And Jin and Hedo were reminded of one dragon at the sight of it.
'It resembles Zephyrin, the dragon of evil. Although this one is incomparably larger.'
As soon as the snake surveyed its surroundings, the whirlpool that was destroying the ground subsided. Jin felt some sort of power in that gaze.
[Jin Runcandel, Hedo… I've never heard these names before. And you two... aren't you not humans?]
The snake seemed quite interested in the fact that the two were humans, licking its lips in amusement.
[Humans digging all the way to me! The world must have changed quite a bit while I was asleep. Indeed, the potential of mortals seems limitless.]
"First of all, I apologize for waking you up. While digging for the gate to the demon world, my sword hit something around your forehead."
[Oh, I see. Then, we may not have the best of relationships. I'm a bit drowsy from just waking up, but I am certainly one who has vowed to guard the boundaries of the world. Ameris, that's my name.]
Of course, Jin and Hedo had never heard the name Ameris before.
"So does that mean we have to defeat you to go further down?"
[Well, I can't answer that for sure since my head might still be down there. But even without my heads, you can't go down.]
"...More heads?"
[Hehe, now that I'm awake, I want to enjoy a fight. Even if you're humans, having come this far, you should provide ample entertainment.]
As soon as Ameris finished speaking, the ground began to sink.
The entire area suddenly sank as much as the pit they had dug. Jin and Hedo positioned themselves as they fell back into the pit.
Looking up, the sky was now far above them. The pit had suddenly turned into a sort of giant arena.
The head of Ameris that had been casting a huge shadow just a moment ago had disappeared as if it was an illusion. Neither Ameris' head nor body could be seen in the pit.
Instead, they saw a woman standing in the middle of the pit, holding a sword. It was Ameris, transformed into a form similar to a human.
[Even if you die, don't resent me. Arrogance and ignorance often come with a heavy price.]
"Have you no intention of having more conversation before we fight?"

[Unlike mortals, immortals are bound by fate. That's the weight of immortality. And my fate is to block those who seek the underworld. If you have the power to defy my fate, we could have more conversation.]
"Well, if it has to be that way, then it can't be helped."
Ameris' power was unpredictable.
However, Jin didn't feel like he was going to lose. His intuition, honed by many battles against transcendent beings and strong opponents, told him so.
'I must not kill.'

There was too much information to discover after subduing her. Though she obstructed their excavation like an annoying gatekeeper, Ameris was more like a treasure they had discovered while digging. Therefore, killing her was off the table for now.
Jin made the first move.
The 5th secret technique of Runcandel, a light-speed stab imbued with the power of the King of the Dead, pierced Ameris right in the front.
[... Isn't this the power of the Kings of the Dead?]
Ameris effortlessly parried the light-speed stab, quickly closing the distance between her and Jin.
"Do you know of the Kings of the Dead?"
Clang-!
As soon as Jin and Ameris's swords clashed, Hedo swung his power at her back. Ameris spun her body to avoid the attack, positioning herself between the two.
[I do, they're the ones who killed a few of my heads. Looking at you now, I see you have a mad heart.]
"That's not what I expected to hear."
[You wouldn't know the Kings of the Dead from then, so don't hold a grudge.]
Despite knowing Jin's relationship with the descendants of her enemies, Ameris didn't show any hostility once the battle began.
Because of this demeanor, Jin found himself oddly liking Ameris. He even felt like he was having a dignified confrontation with a true immortal.
For a while, the three swords intertwined in silence.
Although she wasn't using all her power, Ameris showed no signs of being pushed back while dealing with the two men's swords. Similarly, she wasn't using all her strength either.
Jin, Hedo, and Ameris all inwardly admired each other's swordsmanship.
'But why does Ameris's swordplay feel so familiar?'
Hedo didn't share this sentiment at all, but the longer the battle went on, the more Jin felt an inexplicable sense of déjà vu.
"Ameris, how did you learn to use a sword?"
[I was taught.]
"By whom?"

Instead of answering, Ameris fiercely struck Jin's sword. Before they knew it, Ameris' body was covered in shallow cuts. She didn't possess the rapid regeneration commonly seen among transcendent beings.
In a way, she fought like a human swordsman. Discarding her powers, such as tearing up and collapsing the ground with a mere glance, she engaged in the battle using only pure swordsmanship.
It was a move to maintain her dignity as an immortal.
She thought it was beneath her to go all-out when the mortals were controlling their pace.
Above all, during the fight, Ameris used her insight to read the basic attributes of the two men. She was trying to guess why they were seeking the gate to the demon world.
'They don't seem to be mortals with volatile and dangerous insides. But it wasn't a coincidence that they woke me up. They're certainly looking for the gate to the demon world.'
So, for Ameris, there was no reason yet to resort to all means to kill the two.

'Anyway, it's been a long time since I truly enjoyed the pleasure of swordsmanship. How can mortals, especially humans, reach this level with a lifespan barely over a hundred years? Besides, isn't Jin Runcandel relatively young among humans?'
Shriek...!
[Cough!]
As Ameris blocked Hedo's sword falling onto her forehead, she spat out a mouthful of blood.

'And this human named Hedo's monstrous strength... it's definitely a power imbued with the obsession of a broken sun. He's had it since birth, has he managed to resist corruption? Is it because it's not fully unlocked yet?'
Ameris was becoming more and more interested in the two of them.
The tide of battle was clearly shifting in Jin and Hedo's favor. Although Ameris had been able to fight evenly at first, the two-on-one situation was gradually pushing her to her limit.
If it had been one-on-one, she could have lasted about three hours against Jin and five hours against Hedo. But of course, things would have been different if she was at full strength.
[I concede defeat in this duel. If we continue, I'll just get uglier, so I admit my pride and ignorance have cost me.]
Ameris, who had backed away, sheathed her sword and spoke.
"It was a good match."
[And through our enjoyment of swordsmanship, I've come to see that you have the potential to challenge my fate.]
"Do you mean to say that you'll talk with us and guide us on our way?"

[I can promise the former, but the latter is impossible. If you continue towards the gate to the demon world, you'll have to seriously confront me. Why are you seeking that place? Don't try to fool me with made-up stories. You can't deceive me.]
Jin pondered for a moment. Should he reveal information like the altar of the Sun God to this giant snake he had unexpectedly encountered?
"Before I answer, I'd like to hear one thing as a reward for winning the duel."
[Hmm, that's a request I have to grant as the loser. Ask away.]
"Ameris, you said you're a guardian of the world's boundaries. So, I believe you must know well what lies beneath us, the gate to the demon world, and even deeper underground."
[I do.]
"Then, were you asleep here to prevent the resurrection of the Sun God?"
[I was.]
"Really?"
[I said I was.]
"Could you swear it just once?"
[This is the truth. Yes, I, Ameris, swear on my name. Satisfied? How audacious these mortals are, with their words getting shorter and shorter!]
Jin smiled wryly and reached out his hand towards Ameris.
"Then let's proceed more formally from now on. It seems that you, Ameris, and we share the same purpose."
